audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields refer to Tristana as "his"/"him" (lintFindings: tldr, dontsFull[2].t, report[0].t, report[9].t, report[10].t, report[11].t).
audit.why: Tristana is she/her; the owner is addressed as 'you' so any third-person pronoun refers to the enemy.

Difficulty (7/10, TRICKY) and the level chart (Tristana owns 1-6, Kog'Maw flips at 2+ items) agree between full phases[].side and content win[]; matches the packet's stat-check-early, scale-late shape for this matchup despite the raw win-rate defect flag.
Power spikes (her early all-in mobility, level 6 Buster Shot kill combo, Kog'Maw's 2-item W-shred flip) are already accurately stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real numbers, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad text pasted under titles about landing E first and about racing her spike, neither of which they cover.
audit.why: Rocket Jump (W) is 22/20/18/16/14s and is both her engage and her only escape; Buster Shot (R) is a flat 100s and its knockback finishes an Explosive Charge (E) detonation; E only resets off kills, so denying kills stalls her tempo. None of these real numbers or the E-reset detail reached the page.
audit.corrected: Filled breakdown.cooldowns with real cooldowns and replaced the two copy-paste bullets with content matching their own titles.
